name: Rosegal
description: Rosegal product pages: visible title, item code, prices (the USD base amount in data-orgp, independent of the display currency), lazy-loaded gallery, breadcrumb and attribute list.

verification.note: Assumes h1.goods-title, .goods-sn span, .goods-price .my-shop-price[data-orgp] holding the USD base price (the visible text follows the shopper's currency), .goods-img-list img[data-origin], .crumbs a and a .goods-attr definition list. Not yet checked against saved real pages.
